technique_name: Create a system to indicate quality levels in products.
description:
A quality level system can be created with a set of criteria to rate products according to different categories. For example, every product can be rated on a scale of one to five with one being the lowest level of quality and five being the highest. - Materials used (1 being low-grade materials, 5 being high-grade materials)
